notes.title: KEY REMAPPER! - Weekly Update #1
notes.notes:
For now we plan to release these regular patches roughly every week. (Mind you even this first one is 3 days early so I don't think that sentence will hold up well)

You can reach to us about feedback and feature requests anytime on our Discord or Steam Forums.

This first patch addresses those lovely AZERTY keyboard users and contains general bugfixes for the initial release:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38261797/e428fde3f9c645001241427c7f700fe9180256a4.png


 NEW! added a shiny new "Controls" section to Main and In-game menu so you can check out and remap your keys as you wish.
 Fixed some bugs about discoverable servers not posting to Public Server List
 Holding down your LMB now does not engage the full-auto mad pistol mode anymore
 Added a news and events banner to Main and In-game menu so we can announce certain community play times and events
 Servers now do not register themselves to Steam so you can create a server on a machine and then exit Steam safely without having to close the server
 Minor bugfixes
